card.name: Hedging adverbs inserted mid-sentence
card.fires_on: Hedging or frequency adverbs and modal words such as probably, possibly, often, usually, maybe, might, generally. They sit as asides inside a sentence, often right after a comma or a linking word.

modes.label: Comma-set aside
modes.description: A hedge like probably or possibly sits between commas as a parenthetical aside.
modes.example: It covered,<< probably>>, less than sixteen thousand square leagues.

modes.label: Hedge before a verb or description
modes.description: A softening word such as usually, might, generally or maybe comes before the main verb or the noun phrase it qualifies.
modes.example: a wild goose distinguished by a long neck and wings that are<< usually>> white but sometimes yellow.

card.plain: It fires on small hedging words like probably, usually or maybe that soften a claim in the middle of a sentence.
